title: Capital allocation on decentralized lending platforms
abstract: arXiv:2608.24206v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This work complements our previous paper, which studies borrower-side strategies in decentralized lending markets, by focusing on lender-side capital allocation. We consider a lender who seeks to allocate a fixed budget across multiple markets sharing the same supplied asset. Accounting for the impact of supplied capital on lending rates, we derive closed-form solutions under three interest-rate models: linear, kinked, and adaptive (Morpho's AdaptiveCurveIRM). Backtests are conducted first on USDC and then on WETH Morpho lending markets on Ethereum. We also show that, under the kinked rate model, an allocation that brings a market exactly to the kink is never optimal on the lender side, whereas it can be optimal on the borrower side. This asymmetry may create tension between lenders and borrowers around the kink and thereby exacerbate rate volatility.

translated_title: 去中心化借贷平台上的资本配置
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24206v1 公告类型：新 摘要：本文补充了我们之前的论文，该论文研究了去中心化借贷市场中的借款方策略，本文则聚焦于贷方资本配置。我们考虑一个贷方，在共享同一供应资产的多个市场之间分配固定预算。考虑到供应资本对贷款利率的影响，我们在三种利率模型下推导出闭式解：线性模型、拐点模型和自适应模型（Morpho的AdaptiveCurveIRM）。回测首先在USDC市场进行，然后在以太坊上的WETH Morpho借贷市场进行。我们还表明，在拐点利率模型下，将市场精确配置到拐点的方案在贷方角度永远不是最优的，而在借方角度可能最优。这种不对称性可能在拐点附近造成贷方和借方之间的紧张关系，从而加剧利率波动。
tldr: 本文研究了去中心化借贷平台中贷方资本配置的最优策略，发现拐点利率模型下贷方与借方的优化目标存在不对称性，这可能加剧利率波动。
en_tdlr: This paper studies optimal lender-side capital allocation in decentralized lending platforms, revealing an asymmetry under the kinked rate model where lender and borrower objectives diverge at the kink, potentially exacerbating rate volatility.
